overview_description.description: Fashinza is a B2B marketplace that solves trend forecasting and sourcing for fashion brands and retailers. Fashinza's AI platform crunches data across multiple layers and platforms to predict the upcoming trends and designs. It combines the design platform with its cloud connected network of 200 factories to source products while providing a completely online experience.

about_short_description.short_description: Fashinza is a B2B marketplace that solves trend forecasting and sourcing for fashion brands and retailers.

product.name: Apparel Manufacturing Platform
product.description: A technology platform that manages end-to-end apparel production from design to delivery, providing real-time tracking and supplier communication.

product.name: AI-Driven Supplier Matching
product.description: An AI-powered engine that selects and matches vetted suppliers to brand orders based on data and past performance.

product.name: Forecast-Driven Design Engine
product.description: A design service that provides apparel and fabric designs based on trend forecasting with a turnaround time of about 45 days.

product.name: Smart Factory Production Tracking
product.description: A digital system for real-time monitoring of apparel production with data-driven quality control and error reduction.

product.name: Clothing Catalogue and Sample Ordering
product.description: An online catalogue offering over 200 best-selling apparel designs with options to request samples and place orders.

product.name: Custom Denim Manufacturing
product.description: A service offering bespoke denim apparel production including jeans, jackets, and dresses with customization options.
